stories.title: Follow live: Knicks creating separation vs. new-look 76ers in season opener
Day: Ohio State planning to be without injured Sayin through postseason
stories.summary: Buckeyes coach Ryan Day declined to put a timeline on Julian Sayin's recovery but said they are planning to move forward without him through the rest of the year.

stories.title: George's 38 most by Celtic in debut, but comes in loss: 'I'm not a moral victory guy'
stories.summary: Paul George scored 38 points -- the most by a Celtic in his debut, and the fifth-most by a player in his first game with an NBA franchise -- in a 121-113 collapsing defeat to the Pistons on Tuesday. But as George put it: "I'm not a moral victory guy."

stories.title: Eagles' approach to Hurts 'appropriately guarded,' NFL chief medical officer says
stories.summary: At the owners meetings Tuesday in New York, NFL officials staunchly defended the process involving Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot issue, with chief medical officer Allen Sills addressing reporters in a media availability.

stories.title: Silver: 'No rules issue' with LeBron's helicopter commute
stories.summary: The helicopter used by Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James to commute from New York is "perfectly appropriate," NBA commissioner Adam Silver said on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Tuesday.
